name: Suggestion
description:
Concentration, up to 8 hours.

You suggest a course of action (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature within short range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion cannot be something that would obviously cause the creature harm and must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable.

Roll Persuade vs Riddle against the creature. On a win, the creature pursues the course of action you described to the best of its ability for as long as you maintain concentration, or until the creature finishes the suggested course of action.

You can also specify conditions that will trigger a special activity while the effect is sustained. If the condition isn’t met before the spell expires, the activity isn’t performed.

If you or any of your allies harm the creature, the spell ends.

Describe how you deliver your suggestion.

improvements.name: Mass Suggestion
improvements.description: When you cast this spell, you may spend an additional 4 MP to target up to 10 creatures.
